c-120703bc28f6ff7a.texto: Kardom was a name given to an ax which seems to have been used especially for cutting down trees, and is thought to have had a heavier head than other axes. It is mentioned in Judges 9:48; 1 Sam. 13:20 and Psalm 74:5.

h-2d3e19182c22dd5e.texto: JFB: llamado profético en 629 a.C. (año 13 de Josías, cf. Jr 1:2); ministerio continúa tras la caída de Jerusalén hasta el exilio en Egipto.
